scope: annual detection-sensitive fallback only; attribution within the already-green conventional-filter baseline

analysis.design: leave-one-block-out from the frozen full conventional model
analysis.cross_validation: same leave-one-transition-out folds and sampling-effort scopes as the frozen baseline
analysis.preprocessing: same fold-local transforms and scaling as the frozen baseline
analysis.primary_metric: delta held-out log-loss = drop-block log-loss minus full-model log-loss
analysis.secondary_metric: delta held-out Brier score = drop-block Brier minus full-model Brier

classification_rule.reproducible_incremental_information: pooled primary held-out log-loss worsens when the block is removed and delta log-loss is positive in every primary held-out transition
classification_rule.positive_but_fold_unstable: pooled primary held-out log-loss worsens when the block is removed but at least one primary held-out transition has non-positive delta
classification_rule.no_reproducible_incremental_information: pooled primary held-out log-loss does not worsen when the block is removed

interpretation.allowed: identify which prespecified conventional-filter blocks carry reproducible predictive information for annual link gains or losses
forbidden: ranking blocks as ecological importance scores
tuning block definitions after seeing ablation results
calling any block decision structure or routeability

promotion_rule: A block may be described as carrying reproducible incremental predictive information only under the frozen all-primary-fold sign rule; all other blocks must retain their frozen classification.
claim_ceiling: This analysis can identify predictive asymmetry among independently measured conventional filters. It cannot validate environmental routeability or decision-structural turnover.
